tasks.label: Verify Minikube deployment prerequisites
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Host '--- docker ---'; docker version; Write-Host '--- minikube ---'; minikube status --profile minikube; Write-Host '--- kubectl contexts ---'; kubectl config get-contexts; Write-Host '--- kubectl nodes ---'; kubectl get nodes --context minikube

tasks.label: Deploy registration-login to Minikube
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; docker pull docker.io/surabhi1106/registration-login:v1.0.0; kubectl config use-context minikube; kubectl apply -f Registration-login\k8s\registration-login.yaml; kubectl rollout status deployment/registration-login -n registration-login-staging --timeout=180s; $pod=kubectl get pods -n registration-login-staging -l app=registration-login -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'; kubectl get pods -n registration-login-staging -o wide; kubectl exec -n registration-login-staging $pod -- node -e "const http=require('http'); http.get('http://127.0.0.1:3000/healthz',r=>{console.log('healthz='+r.statusCode); process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)}).on('error',e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1)})"; kubectl exec -n registration-login-staging $pod -- node -e "const http=require('http'); http.get('http://127.0.0.1:3000/readyz',r=>{console.log('readyz='+r.statusCode); process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)}).on('error',e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1)})"

tasks.label: Start Docker Desktop
tasks.command: $dockerDesktop='C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe'; if (Test-Path $dockerDesktop) { Start-Process -FilePath $dockerDesktop; Start-Sleep -Seconds 20; docker version } else { throw 'Docker Desktop executable was not found.' }

tasks.label: Inspect public service endpoint
tasks.command: kubectl get service registration-login -n registration-login-staging -o wide
